quote: We analyze the impact of instruction fine-tuning (IFT) with multilingual arbitration on text verbosity, readability, and lexical diversity. Reward-based routing increases token count by 14.1%, while learned routing leads to a 68.4% increase compared to both single-teacher and random routing baselines. Lexical diversity also improves: reward-based routing achieves a 6% gain, and learned routing 4.2%, relative to single teachers, with 13.4% and 11.5% gains over random routing, respectively.
